description: Fetch a build from an https link (an EAS, Bitrise, S3 or GitHub artifact link, up to the build size limit) into the project; it is checked and ready to run. Nothing to upload from your side. The link must be https to a public host name; up to 3 redirects are followed. headers (optional, at most 5: Authorization or X-… names) are sent to the first host only, for a private artifact store. The file name comes from Content-Disposition or the link; it must be an .apk or a zipped .app. Run the result with run_test {buildId} or run_project {buildIds}. Call find_build first when the file may already be there.

fingerprint.description: Native fingerprint to store with the build, for find_build (optional)

headers.description: Request headers for the link, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer …"} (optional)

label.description: A label, for example the commit (optional)

url.description: https link to the build file

name: import_build
title: Import a build from a link
